traceTitle: address-book/address-book-b2c.spec.ts:58 › Address Book — B2C user › a B2C agent cannot see another organisation address
crossTypeNote: Cross-type, type-agnostic supporting evidence. This trace does not create a notification or select POAO; the delegated journey corpus uses Plant-organisation fixtures, while CHED-P is POAO. Only the rendered organisation-isolation mechanism is carried across.
journeySummary: A B2C user creates an address as 'My organisation branch address'. Carol Clark, acting in a different organisation context, searches for its exact generated name and receives no result; the creating organisation's session can find it.

observations.verbatim: Operator address; My organisation branch address
observations.accessibleName: Operator address / My organisation branch address
observations.meaning: The address book distinguishes organisation-owned branch data from general operator data.

observations.verbatim: No operators have been found. Add a new operator or re-try by amending your search criteria.
observations.accessibleName: No operators have been found. Add a new operator or re-try by amending your search criteria.
observations.meaning: The other-organisation agent cannot retrieve the exact branch-address record.

observations.verbatim: AUTO_2101038cb3_BranchAd; Organisation branch address; Test Lane, Testville, AB12 3CD; View
observations.meaning: The creating organisation can retrieve and open the organisation branch address.

visibilityOwnershipRules.rule: Organisation branch addresses are organisation-scoped: a B2C agent in another organisation cannot see a branch address that the creating organisation can retrieve.

limitations: This is address-book isolation evidence, not notification visibility evidence.
The trace is type-agnostic and supplies no POAO- or CHED-P-specific rendered detail.
